claims.criterion: Before touching anything, a read-only observation is retained: pm2 jlist non-secret fields for oods-forge-bridge (pid, cwd, script, restart count, env key NAMES only), the 4466 listener, checkout HEAD f4cd1ba3 with git status --porcelain empty, sha256 of every file in packages/mcp-server/.oods/schemas including _index.json (16 records + index at the Sprint 188 adoption hashes, 17 hashes), and /health with its revision f4cd1ba3

The primary checkout Forge-expansion is fast-forwarded with git merge --ff-only origin/OODS-pro (git status --porcelain empty before and after; the delivered commit and whether it includes c3a68d5f are recorded); pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm run build:tokens, pnpm run build:packages (the topological workspace build CI's build job uses; it covers @oods/tokens, tw-variants, component-contracts, component-styles, components-react, components-vue, a11y-tools, release-utils, artifacts, viz-core, viz-render and mcp-server), then @oods/mcp-bridge build and pkg:build, all with logs retained; the checked-in structured-data manifest is verified against the delivered head by bytes/ETags, not refreshed

pm2 restart oods-forge-bridge (same cwd and script) then pm2 save; the new PID, cwd, script and 4466 listener are recorded; /health returns ok with 21 auto tools including design_preview and a revision whose build commit equals the delivered commit and whose manifest hash equals the sha256 of the checked-in manifest

Served revision is proven by five discriminating public calls through the bridge, each retained as request/response JSON: design_preview {object:'Subscription', context:'list'} with no loop server running returns the typed OODS-N019 gap (proves the tool is served); design_compose {object:'Subscription', context:'list'} returns a schema declaring the rows collection with bound query, filter and page operands and no unbound SearchInput; code_generate of design_compose {object:'Subscription', context:'workflow'} at profile=build returns App root files in react and vue containing none of workflow-records, workflow-toolbar or workflow-history; design_compose {object:'Subscription', context:'form'} has no label ending with a period and every label at most 40 characters; catalog_list reports the 14 nucleus rows implemented-evidence-complete in react and vue. A green /health alone is never treated as revision proof

The 16 store records and _index.json are byte-identical before and after (17-hash table retained); public schema/load of user-form-showcase returns HTTP 200 with version 2 and the adopted successor hash

The Sprint 189 reconnect is sent via cmos_message to cmos://derek/aquex-mcp and cmos://derek/forge-demos from the prepared notice plan, carrying the served commit, built-file hashes, the Sprint 189 advertised movers and the design_preview addition; both message IDs are recorded; next-step #1415 is completed in CMOS with the message IDs as evidence; Dashboard Demos is not messaged (retired, #1719); cmos-dashboard and dashboard-demos wait for the Sprint 190 reconnect
Rollback is proven executable, not executed: the exact commands to return the primary checkout to f4cd1ba3, rebuild and restart are recorded with the previous build's file hashes

A 13-type render matrix spec calls the public viz.render handler with output.svg:true for every admitted chartType using the existing fixtures (the 5 cartesian and the 8 ECharts-primary golden inputs) and asserts a non-empty svg beginning with <svg, svgHash equal to sha256 of the returned bytes (normalized bytes for the 8), svgBytes equal to the byte length, and the render echo; every result is byte-identical across two consecutive calls (retained as a hash table)

For the 5 cartesian types, svgHash from viz.render at default dimensions equals determinism.renderHash from artifact.certify for the same normalized spec; a mutation bite that changes the compiled spec (or the shared renderer's output) moves both hashes together and the identity test detects a deliberate divergence

A renderer-throw bite (the VL or ECharts leg made to throw in-test) yields a typed OODS-V1xx error with status error and no svg field, never a spec-only status ok; the error code is registered in the error registry and docs

dashboard.render output.html for a fixture dashboard containing all 11 admitted panel types contains 11 rendered SVG chart cells and zero 'geo' placeholder sections; the placeholder remains only for an error panel fixture; outputHtmlHash is byte-stable across two calls; the existing cartesian panel bytes are unchanged (the dashboard HTML goldens that move are the 6 ECharts-primary cells and are updated with per-file attribution stating why)

Vega-Lite SVG output preserves role=graphics-object and aria-roledescription (the existing a11y-by-construction test extended to the public path); ECharts SVG output carries the normalized structural tokens per the s179 normalizer

Schemas, generated types (generate:schema-types --check), docs/api/viz-render.md and dashboard-render.md (docs:api --check), and the 14-file colocated golden list (ci-golden-list.guard) are updated and green; the viz-core, viz-render and mcp-server colocated viz suites pass; root typecheck passes; no full-suite capture

@oods/tokens dist exports cssVariablesByScope with exactly the brands A and B and the themes light, dark and hc, each a map derived from the same token sources as the CSS scopes (a spec compares three named tokens per scope against the values in dist/css/tokens.css); sha256 of the flat cssVariables export and of dist/css/tokens.css are identical before and after this mission (hash pair retained) so vendored consumers are unaffected

AMENDED (build session, 2026-09-09): the default scope for every viz resolver is the scoped light/A values, not the flat map. The flat cssVariables map viz-core resolved before this mission is the base layer, not the light/A theme, so the previous 'byte-identical default' criterion was wrong and is withdrawn. A retained receipt lists every token whose value differs between the flat map and the scoped light/A map. Every existing viz-core, viz-render and mcp-server colocated golden that moves because of that difference is updated in this mission, before any capture, with per-file attribution naming the tokens that changed it (learning #543); no golden moves for any other reason, and a golden that does not move is listed as unchanged

The viz-render emitter applies tokens: the replaced test asserts that rendering with the dark-scope tokens changes the SVG bytes and that the canvas fill equals the resolved --oods-sys-surface-canvas for that scope; the un-themed golden is replaced by a light/A-scope golden (attribution in the commit and README); the two 'Light-only' comments no longer exist in packages/viz-core/src/tokens

A 13 x 3 x 2 matrix (chartType x theme x brand = 78 SVGs) through the public viz.render handler with output.svg:true is byte-stable across two runs, and for every type the dark and hc SVGs differ from light while the canvas fill in each equals the resolved --oods-sys-surface-canvas for its scope; omitting theme and brand yields bytes identical to theme:'light', brand:'A'; the hash table and per-type canvas check are retained

dashboard.render output.html with theme:'dark' sets data-theme='dark' (and data-brand) on the document, draws all 11 panels with dark-scope chrome, and its outputHtmlHash differs from the light render and is byte-stable; the light/A output moves only by the attributed token differences and is otherwise identical to the m02 head

An invalid theme or brand value is rejected by the input schema with the existing typed validation error; schemas, generated types, docs/api pages and the golden list guard are updated and green; viz-core, viz-render and mcp-server colocated viz suites pass; root typecheck passes; no full-suite capture

Component value tests: VizAreaPreview with an svg prop renders a figure with role=img, the given aria-label and the SVG markup verbatim (ids and ARIA preserved, no <script>, no external href) in HTML, React and Vue with computed parity and an empty allowlist; without svg it renders the existing placeholder text unchanged

Fresh design.compose Subscription/detail contains exactly one VizAreaPreview at the top of the detail screen bound to an area chart declaration over payment events with the amount in major units; the declaration is part of the public schema (repl.ui.schema.json and generated types updated) and no other object's schemas move (census diff against the m03 head enumerated per schema: class (h) chart placement on Subscription/detail only; anything else fails); 66/66 schemas and 132/132 cells stay green

code.generate Subscription/detail and Subscription/workflow at profile=build in both frameworks embed SVG rendered through the public viz.render leg (the embedded bytes' sha256 equals the svgHash viz.render returns for the same declaration, theme and data), one per seeded record in the workflow app, selected by id; artifacts typecheck strict in both frameworks; two generations are byte-identical

Design-loop receipts for Subscription/detail (review state, the Team annual record) in React and Vue at 390/820/1440: the accessibility dump contains the figure role with the chart's name and a graphics-object role inside it; the screenshot shows the area chart above Status Timeline; no page or console errors; no element exceeds the viewport at 390 (the SVG scales to its container); computed React/Vue visible-text and accessible-name parity is empty
The s188 flow harness (list -> detail -> edit -> save -> cancel -> timeline) and the 32 state observations still pass in both frameworks with the chart present on detail

Rendering the detail with preferences.theme:'dark' embeds the dark-scope SVG (canvas fill check) and the design-loop receipt records it; focused suites for the composer, emitters, components and loop pass; no full-suite capture

artifact.certify with theme:'dark' renders its own leg at the dark scope: for all 5 cartesian types and each shipped theme, determinism.renderHash equals viz.render svgHash at default dimensions for the same normalized spec (15 or 10 identities retained as a table); the m02 identity bite still discriminates

Contrast rows per theme are present in certify output for the 5 cartesian types and retained; every 'dark-theme contrast is not verified' or equivalent disclaimer in packages/mcp-server/src/tools is removed or rewritten to name the measured scopes exactly (grep receipt retained); coverage for the 8 ECharts-primary types remains uncertified with conformant:null and the accuracy rule counts are unchanged

packages/viz-core/src/registry/viz-recipes.v1.json has exactly 13 rows with the declared cells; every cell value is measured by scripts/product-reality/s190-viz-census.ts through public handlers (the script imports no private module; a test pins its import list); the contract test asserting registry == census passes; a mutation bite that flips one registry cell by hand fails the contract test

The registry reports, at the m05 head: publicSvg true for 13/13; dashboardDrawn true for 11 and 'excluded (#881)' for chord and flow_map; themes light and dark true for 13/13 (hc per m03's outcome); certifyCoverage certified for the 5 and uncertified for the 8; chartInApp placed for area (Subscription/detail) and not-placed for the other 12; a11yDescription true for 13/13

docs/api/artifact-certify.md, viz-render.md and dashboard-render.md carry the parameter and coverage sentences derived from the registry (docs:api --check green); schemas, generated types and the golden list guard updated; viz-core, viz-render and mcp-server colocated viz suites pass; root typecheck passes; no full-suite capture

Fresh viz census at the frozen implementation head (scripts/product-reality/s190-viz-census.ts) equals the committed registry, reports publicSvg 13/13, dashboardDrawn 11/11 plus the two #881 exclusions, themes light and dark 13/13 (hc per the m03 outcome), render-certify identity for the 5 cartesian types at every shipped scope, and chartInApp placed for Subscription/detail; the 78-SVG (or 52 if hc was descoped) hash matrix is rendered twice at the frozen head and byte-stable; all retained under artifacts/product-reality/sprint-190/m06/

Fresh component census at the frozen head: 66/66 schemas and 132/132 cells, Subscription/workflow 2/2, the wider 77-schema population unchanged at 75/77 with the Organization/User workflow OODS-N016 gaps disclosed; the per-schema diff from the c3a68d5f census lists only Subscription/detail under class (h) chart placement and nothing else; original and successor saved stores unchanged (15/16 and 16/16, 17 live hashes unchanged)

The s188 flow harness, 32 state observations and screenshots pass at the frozen head in both frameworks; the design-loop AFTER receipts for Subscription/detail in both frameworks at 390/820/1440 in light and dark are retained with hashes and show the chart

One four-suite capture under #1833 (viz-core, viz-render, mcp-server, root) with zero assertion failures; a lone wall-clock timeout with no assertion failure receives exactly one isolated rerun retained beside the original and is disclosed; skips equal the same 16 pre-existing identities or the change is attributed by file; every golden that moved in m02-m05 is attributed by file in the suite accounting; at most one corrective full capture, only after a code fix

Sprint-wide advertised-surface diff computed once from git diff --name-only c3a68d5f..HEAD over the advertised path set (viz.render, dashboard.render, artifact.certify and design.compose schemas, generated types, repl.ui.schema.json, docs, policy, registry, the @oods/tokens and @oods/viz-core exports); the reconnect draft names the movers, the frozen SHA for the vendored consumers (dashboard-demos, forge-demos) and the registry answer to the 11-of-13 question, and is retained unsent

A claim ledger binds every m01-m06 criterion to an execution with paths that exist at the frozen head and match their hashes, re-derived by the independent auditor script; near.md gains an Increment 9 section at BUILT, REVIEW PENDING and the program's Visualization and Dashboard HTML rows are updated from the registry without relabeling the sprint as certified; the prose contract tests pass at the frozen head

The review handoff records builderSelfCertified:false, separateReviewRequired:true, the frozen implementation, execution and evidence commits, the registry, the matrix and the receipts the reviewer must inspect; Sprint 190 stays Active; a PR from codex/sprint-190-viz-public-render to OODS-pro is opened with remote CI observed and its run ids recorded (pkg-compat, viz-determinism and coverage included)
